name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: A tab bar: a pointer clicks each tab in turn, the indicator slides to it, the label darkens and the panel text cross-fades.
useWhen: A settings or dashboard demo needs to switch sections with an animated indicator.
Showing tab navigation with content that changes underneath.
avoidWhen: A segmented single-choice control without panels: use toggle-group.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Panel texts
variables.description: Panel text per tab, separated by |.
variables.default: Make changes to your account here.|Change your password here.|Manage your notification settings.

variables.label: Panel height
variables.description: Height of the panel area in design pixels.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the interaction. Above 1 it finishes early and holds the last state.

variables.label: Transparent background
variables.description: Skip the theme background so the control sits on your own scene.
